note: average of 3 draws of ar_134naclh_tww (pipeline/45_bag_draw.sh, then scripts/bag_build.py), then the plan-window step zf3 (pipeline/46_bag_file.sh). cv_rmse is the single-draw chain's on the two validation folds: the draws share one out-of-fold side (2025 files are not redrawn), so the bag has no cross-validation score of its own; estimated_gain_rmse (negative = lower RMSE) is the variance argument in scripts/bag_build.py (draw-to-draw rms differences), an estimate and not a measurement.
